title: Hold a food safety scheme accreditation
what: Carry out activities covered by a food safety scheme (such as meat, dairy, seafood, egg or plant products) only under an accreditation.

sources.title: Primary Produce (Food Safety Schemes) Act 2004 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A producer of primary produce must not engage in a class of activities to which a food safety scheme applies without an accreditation if accreditation is required by the food safety scheme

reach.condition: if a food safety scheme applies to its primary produce (such as meat, dairy, seafood or eggs)

sources.title: Primary Produce (Food Safety Schemes) Act 2004 (SA)
